name: end-gate-reconstructs-twice
body: Two limits on the End gate. (1) It reads `dirty_node_files_from_db`'s full dirty-node reconstruction for a yes/no decision, and `pending_changes_message` re-reads it on a refusal, so refusing over a very large dirty set reconstructs twice; upgrade to a COUNT-only probe on `ArtifactDb` if session-end refusal latency ever matters. (2) The gate trusts the admission path to mark dirty rows: an admission that projected without marking would let `end` release silently — an invariant that lives in `apply_mutation` and is pinned by the routed positive mark assertions in the session e2e, not here.
